chunks: And whatever is in it from Ismaʿil ibn Mihran regarding the words of Faṭimah, peace be upon her, I have narrated it from Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAli ibn al-Husayn al-Saʿdābādī, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi, from his father, from Ismaʿil ibn Mihran, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Khuzaʿi, from Muhammad ibn Jabir, from ʿAbbād al-ʿAmiri, from Zaynab daughter of Amir al-Muʾminin, peace be upon them, from Faṭimah, peace be upon her.

key_terms.إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ: the transmitter from whom these reports are said to come
key_terms.زَيْنَبَ بِنْتِ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ع: Zaynab, daughter of Amir al-Muʾminin, in the line of transmission
key_terms.فَقَدْ رَوَيْتُهُ: I have narrated it; a formula indicating the compiler’s route of transmission
key_terms.كَلَامِ فَاطِمَةَ عَلَيْهَا السَّلَامُ: the words or statements attributed to Faṭimah, peace be upon her

ai.seo_question: What is the chain of transmission for the reports from Ismaʿil ibn Mihran about the words of Faṭimah عليها السّلام in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage is a transmission-chain notice specifying the sanad through which the compiler narrates reports from Ismaʿil ibn Mihran concerning the words of Faṭimah عليها السّلام. Its significance lies in documenting provenance and preserving the line of transmission through named narrators, including Zaynab bint Amir al-Muʾminin عليهما السّلام.
